items.reason: Immediate cancellation is necessary here: handleNewBooking.ts:978 calls EventManager.reschedule(), which deletes the old booking at packages/core/EventManager.ts:290-297. The onDelete: Cascade relation at packages/prisma/schema.prisma:637 deletes its reminders, so merely setting cancelled would remove the cron’s cancellation record before it could process it; requestReschedule instead retains the booking.

The claim that no cascade removes these rows is false: packages/core/EventManager.ts:290-297 deletes the old booking during rescheduling, and packages/prisma/schema.prisma:637 cascades that deletion to WorkflowReminder. Although emailReminderManager.ts:213-222 does not explicitly delete the row, the successful reschedule removes it.
